fuzz.name: Full HTTP surface
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary requests on the full router; oracles: no panic, no 500, no write outside the data roots, never a success without valid credentials

fuzz.name: WebDAV listings
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary PROPFIND bodies; the XML response is always well-formed

fuzz.name: WebDAV property updates
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary PROPPATCH bodies; the XML response is always well-formed

fuzz.name: WebDAV search
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary SEARCH (RFC 5323) bodies; the XML response is always well-formed

fuzz.name: Headers and file names
fuzz.checks: Paths, Destination, Range, If-Match, checksums, mtimes, Host, forms, uploaded file names

fuzz.name: Web search
fuzz.checks: Web search syntax; folding is stable and highlighting is exact; wildcard patterns folded, bounded, and their matching always ends

fuzz.name: Backup manifest
fuzz.checks: Identity manifests read back from external storage; what is kept rereads identically

fuzz.name: Images (thumbnails)
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary images through the JPEG decoder and thumbnailer; bounded memory, valid output

fuzz.name: Restore from a snapshot
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary source trees (any name, links) restored; always succeeds, existing items untouched, nothing written outside the target, faithful copies

fuzz.name: OIDC destination grammar
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary text as an `https` URL (issuer, discovery endpoints, back-channel hosts); never a panic, an accepted URL keeps its bytes and a lowercase host, port 1-65535

fuzz.name: OIDC provider responses
fuzz.checks: Arbitrary provider responses (discovery document, token response, `id_token`); refused or parsed, never a panic

models.name: File operations
models.checks: Model-based: random MKCOL, PUT, DELETE, MOVE, COPY sequences vs an in-memory model; tree, contents, file identities, folder ETags after every step

models.name: Sharing links
models.checks: Model-based: random link creations, changes, revocations through the OCS API; what clients list and what a guest can actually do

models.name: User isolation
models.checks: User isolation: random requests from one user, aimed at another user of the same tenant (his WebDAV path, traversal, Destination, file ids, his link), never succeed on his space, never return his names or contents, change no byte, xattr or database row of his

models.name: Password policy
models.checks: Password policy: below the length always refused; a password accepted at a minimum stays accepted at a lower one and never contains the account name

models.name: Password set by the administrator
models.checks: Password set by the administrator: random sets, refusals, disable/enable, sign-ins on 4 accounts in 2 tenants; must change exactly when the administrator set it, any change ends that account's sessions only

models.name: Two-step verification
models.checks: Two-step verification: random setups, codes, recovery codes, renewals, turn-offs and clock moves against a model; a code passes once inside ±1 step, a recovery code once and only from the latest set

models.name: TOTP codes
models.checks: TOTP: any secret and time, a code is accepted only inside the window and never twice

models.name: Tenant isolation
models.checks: Tenant isolation: random requests from one tenant's user, hostile ones included, change no byte, xattr or database row of another tenant

models.name: Post-login redirect
models.checks: No open redirect: whatever the input, the post-login return address stays on the same site

models.name: Mobile QR login
models.checks: The mobile login QR code parses back, as the Nextcloud apps parse it, into exactly the user, password and server

models.name: Restore by file copy
models.checks: Restore by file copy with the manifest: for any content and any change since the backup, identity and ETag follow the content, contents never altered

models.name: Restore from a snapshot
models.checks: beastbox restore: for any snapshot and current tree, existing items unchanged, copy equal to the source, no identity held twice

models.name: Name of a restored copy
models.checks: beastbox restore: the name given to a copy is always a legal name, keeps the extension and fits the length bound

models.name: Search wildcards
models.checks: Search wildcards: the linear matcher agrees with the obvious recursive definition of * and ?, on texts where they collide with letters

models.name: Folder link at an item
models.checks: Folder link at an item: whatever the folder and page sizes, the page chosen holds the item

models.name: Names of copies
models.checks: Copy and duplicate: for any name, the names tried are the name first, then all different, legal, a file's extension kept last

security.what: Nothing a user sends touches or reveals another user's files, xattrs, links or database rows in the same tenant
Nothing a tenant's user sends touches another tenant's files, xattrs or database rows

Only the account an administrator bound to the provider identity signs in; the flow is bound to its tenant and to the browser session, and nothing the provider returns is trusted beyond the verified TLS channel
Unknown host refused; every route of the table requires a tenant (route audit)
Every SQL query filters by tenant (query audit)
No success on a protected route without valid credentials (also a fuzz oracle)

security.rule: App passwords bound to their account
security.what: Another user's app password, hostile user names, malformed Authorization headers refused
Failures limited per IP and per tenant; windows expire exactly
Changing a password ends the account's web sessions; turning on two-step verification ends the other ones
Minimum length (setting, never below 10), no account or tenant name, no repeated characters, sequences or keyboard rows, not the current one
Replaced at the first sign-in; until then the session opens nothing else and no device connects
No sign-in, sessions ended, devices and public links blocked while disabled
Every command run as the real binary on real ZFS datasets: exit code, output and effect; the other user and the other tenant untouched
security.tests: cli::usage_and_version, cli::check_config_and_unknown_tenant, cli::user_add_refusals, cli::user_add_on_a_dataset, cli::user_list_columns, cli::user_passwd, cli::user_disable_enable, cli::user_2fa_reset, cli::verify_and_rescan, cli::manifest_and_restore, cli::serve_answers

security.what: TOTP (RFC 6238) after the password, web and Login Flow; each code once (in SQL too); 5 wrong codes per account per 15 minutes; recovery codes single use; required tenants hold the session until set up
Wrong password, expiry, revocation, download limit, other tenant, rotated link key
Concurrency caps, file count, sizes, slow-body timeout (slowloris), sanitized file names
Traversal, symlinks, reserved names refused (SafePath, openat with O_RESOLVE_BENEATH)
Atomic writes under a real kill -9: never a torn file, identity kept
The whole server runs in capability mode; global namespace access refused (ECAPMODE)
CSRF token on every POST form; no inline script, style or handler (strict CSP); no innerHTML/eval; no dead CSS
The post-login return address only accepts same-site client links
Public pages (login, links, errors, device login) never show the version
One-time display, CSRF, app password expires after 10 minutes if unused
A past version comes back beside the current one, as new items; links never followed; a failure leaves the partial copy in the trash
An identity and an ETag come back only to a file whose content is proven identical (SHA-1)
Wildcards: 64 characters at most, matching bounded by the pattern and name lengths (never exponential)
